data_status: verified numeric subset, mostly secondary mirror; incomplete historical frontier
snapshot: BenchLeader AA Progress Index values, data as of 2026-11-02; all plotted scores use this mirror

methodology.model_variant: Maximum observed Progress Index score among each model's reported effort variants; mirrors may not preserve fallback configuration labels.
methodology.company_series: At each release date, running maximum score among observed model records for that company.
methodology.country_series: At each release date, running maximum among observed companies belonging to the selected country.
methodology.interpolation: none; render as a step function. Do not invent intermediate records.

provenance.numeric_source: BenchLeader model pages and benchmark leaderboard, which explicitly attribute Progress Index values to Artificial Analysis

limitations: This is an observed subset of the historical models, not the complete AA chart dataset. Running maxima computed from this subset can miss uncollected releases and understate a frontier between observed releases.

The official AA chart is not accessible for raw value extraction in this environment. Official text extraction omits plotted values; direct AA browser and network requests were blocked. The AA data API requires an API key.
AA refits scores as models are added. Mirrors disagree: BenchLeader gives Gemini 4 Carbon 350.8, while a different mirror reports 351.6; use these records consistently and do not mix snapshots.

Some mirror release metadata are ambiguous or alias versions. Five records are specifically flagged with release_date_alias_conflict; preserve those warnings in exported data and do not claim these dates have primary verification.
The page must label this as a numeric reconstruction from a secondary AA mirror and a partial dataset, not a complete original AA data export.
Official AA methodology anchors (o3-mini high=220; GPT-5.5 xhigh=320) are methodological references; they are not additional invented or interpolated plotted observations.

The original chart includes more historic models. The earliest reliable plotted record in this reconstruction is GPT-4 on 2023-03-14; the original GPT-3.5 Turbo mirror date/score identity is ambiguous and excluded.

chart_guidance.caption_zh: AA Progress Index v1｜数值重绘（BenchLeader 转录自 Artificial Analysis，历史模型子集）
chart_guidance.footnote_zh: 使用公开数值而非图片描线；时间线为已收录模型的历史最高分。数据不完整，部分版本日期尚有别名冲突；分数会随 AA 重拟合而变化。
chart_guidance.render: Step-after line; one real release-date event per observed model. At each company/date retain only the maximum score. Carry-forward is rendering only, not a fabricated model observation.
chart_guidance.country_scope: US/CN filters should exclude FR/AE when active. US or CN aggregated frontier is the maximum among observed companies, not a claim of a complete national frontier.
